mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases discount rates for equity cash flows, compressing valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% over 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 and retail sales (RSAFS) above 740000 indicates robust consumer demand that boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 740000 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime characterized by declining industrial production (INDPRO < 102.0), reduced manufacturing output and higher input costs suppress corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 102.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 330.5) triggers anticipated Federal Reserve tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 330.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong real GDP growth (GDPC1 > 24000) indicates expanding economic activity that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 exceeds 24000 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 159000) boosts consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 159000 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO > 102.0) reflects robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO exceeds 102.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.
